# Bundled Python packages

`nats/` and `nats_py-2.16.0.dist-info/` are nats-py 2.16.0
(https://github.com/nats-io/nats.py), unpacked unchanged from the PyPI wheel
`nats_py-2.16.0-py3-none-any.whl` (sha256
`aeb1ff123966c05833d26c7df7e1d54c1c6d32b612428b21677a2e921f1fecae`). It is
licensed under the Apache License 2.0, a copy of which is in
`LICENSE-nats-py.txt`. The live stream and the sleep analysis jobs use it only
when the biometrics environment has no nats-py installed.
